intro: Dear Founders, Investors, and Friends, Crypto's political influence just hit a new high with Fairshake crossing $193 million, while illicit flows surged to record levels. The week reminds us that innovation and regulation are locked in an ongoing dance.

top_signals.title: Crypto's political power supercharged with $193 million in Fairshake, thanks to new cash
top_signals.summary: Fairshake, a crypto industry campaign-finance arm, has received an additional $49 million, bringing its total to $193 million. This surpasses its funding for previous U.S. congressional races, indicating a significant increase in crypto's political influence. [1]

top_signals.title: Illicit crypto flows surge to record $158bn
top_signals.summary: Illicit crypto flows have surged to a record $158 billion, indicating a sharp rise in money sent to criminal wallets after a period of decline. [2]

top_signals.title: Bullion, Billions, and the Blockchain: Tether Scores $5 Billion From Gold Rally
top_signals.source: Financial and Business News | Finance Magnates
top_signals.summary: Tether has reportedly gained $5 billion from its gold holdings due to the recent gold rally. This development has also reignited scrutiny over the company's reserves and asset backing. [3]

top_signals.title: Gold Coast firm fined $14m over Qoin cryptocurrency
top_signals.summary: The company behind the Qoin cryptocurrency has been fined $14 million by the Federal Court following legal action. The corporate watchdog pursued the case against the Gold Coast-based firm. [4]

linkedin_post: Dear Founders, Investors, and Friends, Crypto's political influence is surging. Fairshake, the industry's key campaign-finance group, now holds over $193 million in cash. This includes fresh infusions like $25 million from Coinbase, $25 million from Ripple, and $24 million from a16z. The total dwarfs its 2024 spending, signaling a massive push to shape the 2026 midterms. Pro-crypto candidates won big last cycle, paving the way for stablecoin laws and friendlier regulators. Now, eyes are on market structure legislation to clarify SEC and CFTC roles. At Blockwall, we see this as a pivotal moment for European builders to align with global momentum. Yet challenges persist. Illicit crypto flows hit a record $158 billion last year. After a decline, money to criminal wallets spiked sharply. This underscores the need for robust compliance and innovation in tracking tools. Responsible protocols can turn scrutiny into strength. On a brighter note, Tether reaped $5 billion from its gold reserves amid the recent rally. This windfall highlights blockchain's ties to traditional assets like bullion. It also sparks fresh questions on reserve transparency, pushing the sector toward even stronger backing. These stories blend opportunity with accountability. At Blockwall, our European crypto VC portfolio thrives on such dynamics. We back teams building the compliant, scalable future. What trends are you watching in crypto's evolving landscape? #Web3 #Crypto #Blockchain #CryptoVC
